newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-COVENTRY CHAIRMAN SLAPS WAGE FREEZE ON FIRST TEAM SQUAD.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-COVENTRY CHAIRMAN SLAPS WAGE FREEZE ON FIRST TEAM SQUAD.

text.p: Coventry chairman Bryan Richardson has slapped a wages freeze on his first team squad until results improve.
Coventry are struggling in the basement of the English premier League and last week were dumped out of the League Cup by second division Gillingham.

Richardson's wage freeze came on the day the club announced losses of 7.5 7.5 million pounds ($12.6 million) in the last financial year. They now have total debts of almost 20 million pounds ($33.6 million).
"If the results improve and we are winning matches, then fine. But salaries will not increase until we see better results," said Richardson. "It is a basic salary freeze."
